vars.query: MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND (n.arr) AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' WITH n.arr AS xs UNWIND xs AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' WITH n.arr AS xs WITH xs AS ys UNWIND ys AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x + 1 AS value ORDER BY value
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x WITH x WHERE x > 1 RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN DISTINCT x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.text AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.flags AS x RETURN x AND true AS value ORDER BY value
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.floats AS x RETURN x / 2 AS value ORDER BY value
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.single AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.tag AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.keep AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' WITH collect(n.arr) AS lists UNWIND lists AS xs UNWIND xs AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND [1,1] AS duplicate UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x WITH x ORDER BY x SKIP 1 LIMIT 1 RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x MATCH (m:UnwindTarget) WHERE m.role = 'target' RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN collect(DISTINCT x)
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'b' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'missing' UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) UNWIND n.arr AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode)-[r:UnwindEdge]->(m:UnwindTarget) WHERE n.tag = 'a' AND r.role = 'target' UNWIND r.arr AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:UnwindNode)-[r:UnwindEdge]->(m:UnwindTarget) WHERE n.tag = 'a' AND r.role = 'target' WITH r.arr AS xs UNWIND xs AS x RETURN x + 1 AS value ORDER BY value
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x WITH x WHERE x = 1 MATCH (t:UnwindTarget) WHERE t.role = 'target' SET t.value = x + 10
MATCH (n:UnwindNode)-[r:UnwindEdge]->(m:UnwindTarget) WHERE n.tag = 'a' AND r.role = 'target' UNWIND r.arr AS x WITH r,x WHERE x = 3 SET r.value = x + 10
MATCH (n:UnwindNode) WHERE n.tag = 'a' UNWIND n.arr AS x CREATE (c:UnwindCreated {value:x})

MATCH (n:UnwindCreated) RETURN n.value AS value ORDER BY value
